ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Vivaldi_elf.DLL Sideloading
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of "vivaldi_elf.dll" Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\vivaldi\\_elf\\\.dll$") AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\Vivaldi\\\\Application\\\\vivaldi\\\.exe$") AND ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\Vivaldi\\\\Application\\\\.*")))
